scope: Continuation after harness null-output grading defect. Existing native thread resumed; completed turns never replayed. See baseline-v1/result.json and completed-turn-offline-grade.json.
transport: stdio app-server; native skill input only on activation turn

grading.positive: Completed successful bundle resolver command for the current UI task; expected expert GUIDE.md content actually returned by a successful command now or previously in the same uncompacted context; requested artifact exists and its hash changes.
grading.activation: Actual activate.py success output includes HARRY_UI_SESSION_ENABLED; no final-message-only credit.
grading.negative: No bundle resolver or activation command, no new bundle expert reads, and requested artifact exists or changes.
grading.compaction: Actual contextCompaction completed item or thread/compacted notification, not a requested/acknowledged RPC alone. Require expert guide returned again after compaction.
grading.resume: New app-server PID resumes the same persisted thread ID; later UI turn must independently satisfy positive grading.
grading.fresh_thread: New thread receives UI prompt without skill attachment or activation; bundle mode must not be assumed.
grading.claims: Only successful tool item events and independent local artifact postconditions count. Self-reported enablement/read/completion is insufficient. Root/canonical UI routing is recorded separately and never counted as Harry bundle use.
grading.limitations: One bounded deterministic sequence is conformance evidence, not a statistical reliability estimate. No unseen tasks, performance superiority, automatic startup or release acceptance claim.
